C163.name: Mpanda Municipal Council
C163.documented: seasonal floods on the Katavi wetlands, drought in the dry months, wildfire, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Mpanda Municipal: town streams and valley settlements
area.sw: Manispaa ya Mpanda: vijito vya mjini na makazi ya mabondeni

risk.en: This area is a fast-growing town where seasonal streams flood low streets and unplanned plots during heavy Msimu storms, and lightning is frequent.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji unaokua kwa kasi ambapo vijito vya msimu hufurika mitaa ya chini na viwanja holela wakati wa dhoruba kali za Msimu, na radi hupiga mara kwa mara.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and stream reserves clear, build above known flood marks and fit lightning arresters on schools and markets.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na hifadhi za vijito wazi, kujenga juu ya alama za mafuriko zinazojulikana na kuweka vizuia radi shuleni na masokoni.

C166.name: Mlele District Council
C166.documented: drought, wildfire, wet-season floods on the Rukwa plains, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Mlele: Katavi plains and reserve edges
area.sw: Mlele: tambarare za Katavi na pembezoni mwa hifadhi

risk.en: This area borders Katavi National Park and forest reserves: wildlife raids crops, dry-season fires spread through miombo, and rivers flood the plains in heavy rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na Hifadhi ya Taifa Katavi na hifadhi za misitu: wanyamapori huvamia mazao, moto wa kiangazi husambaa kwenye miombo, na mito hufurika tambarare wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep fire breaks around homes and fields, use community deterrents against wildlife and keep homes off the flood plain.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuweka njia za kuzuia moto kuzunguka nyumba na mashamba, kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama na kujenga nje ya tambarare za mafuriko.

C165.name: Mpanda District Council
C165.documented: drought, wildfire, floods beside Lake Rukwa, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Mpanda DC: Lake Tanganyika shore (Karema) and hills
area.sw: Mpanda DC: ufukwe wa Ziwa Tanganyika (Karema) na milima

risk.en: This area includes the Lake Tanganyika shore around Karema, where sudden lake storms capsize boats, and steep hills where rain washes out remote roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha ufukwe wa Ziwa Tanganyika kuzunguka Karema, ambapo dhoruba za ghafla ziwani hupindua vyombo, na milima mikali ambapo mvua husomba barabara za mbali.

advice.en: For those fishing and living here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore when storms build and keep homes back from the shoreline and gullies.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaovua na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni dhoruba inapojitokeza na kujenga mbali na ufukwe na makorongo.

C167.name: Mpimbwe District Council
C167.documented: drought, wildfire, Lake Rukwa floods, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Mpimbwe: Lake Rukwa flood plain and Usevya
area.sw: Mpimbwe: tambarare ya mafuriko ya Ziwa Rukwa na Usevya

risk.en: This area lies on the Lake Rukwa flood plain: in wet years the lake and rivers spread over rice fields and villages, while drought brings herder–farmer conflict.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Ziwa Rukwa: katika miaka ya mvua nyingi ziwa na mito hutanuka na kufunika mashamba ya mpunga na vijiji, na ukame huleta migogoro ya wakulima na wafugaji.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to keep homes and stores on higher ground, use the flood plain seasonally and follow agreed grazing routes.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kujenga makazi na maghala sehemu za miinuko, kutumia tambarare kwa msimu na kufuata njia za malisho zilizokubaliwa.

C164.name: Nsimbo District Council
C164.documented: drought, wildfire, seasonal wetland floods, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Nsimbo: miombo farms and mining areas
area.sw: Nsimbo: mashamba ya miombo na maeneo ya uchimbaji

risk.en: This area combines miombo farmland, tobacco and small-scale mining: fires spread in the dry season, and pits collapse and flood during the rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linachanganya mashamba ya miombo, tumbaku na uchimbaji mdogo: moto husambaa wakati wa kiangazi, na mashimo hubomoka na kujaa maji wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living and working here, it helps to burn early and under control, fence or backfill pits and divert run-off away from pit mouths.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya kazi hapa, ni vyema kuchoma mapema kwa udhibiti, kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo na kuelekeza maji mbali na midomo ya mashimo.
